name: Venti
notes: Both sources give Venti more than one build; the card follows the support build (KQM's first, Game8's Elemental Mastery Swirl): 4pc Viridescent Venerer (KQM calls it uncontested best in slot), EM on every piece with ER or ATK% on the Sands, and Elegy for the End first. Scaling is EM because Swirl damage and the Viridescent Venerer buff run on it. Both sources also give a DPS build (ATK% Sands, Anemo DMG Goblet, CRIT Circlet; 4pc A Day Carved From Rising Winds with The Daybreak Chronicles first, Aqua Simulacra for Game8's Crit Burst build), and those sets and weapons are kept after the support ones. Talent order: KQM gives none; Game8 gives Burst > Skill > Normal Attack for the Sub-DPS and Normal Attack first only for its Hexerei Main DPS, so Burst first is used. Damage lines: Wind's Grand Ode DoT 37.6% to 67.7%, Skyward Sonnet 276% to 497%, both on the elemental curve. ER is KQM's range for 2 Skills in a short rotation solo Anemo (145-165); 160 is used (1 Skill needs 175-210, triple Anemo 110-160). No source gives EM or CRIT goals. Partners are the elements Viridescent Venerer shreds.
